entities.name: Szarel
entities.description: Eumidian druid from the Edge, lead officer for the current stage of terrasymbiosis on Evendo, defending it from Kav colonists.

entities.name: Eumidians
entities.description: Terraforming people who seed themselves across the stars by terrasymbiosis.

entities.name: Kav
entities.description: Colonists who attempt to claim Evendo for themselves.

entities.name: Terrasymbiosis
entities.description: Eumidian technique of terraforming while their biology adapts to the world.

events.summary: Szarel manages Evendo's terrasymbiosis while defending it from Kav colonists, knowing he will not live to see it completed.
events.quote: Szarel is fully aware that he will not live to see the project's completion

relations.quote: Szarel is an Eumidian druid from the Edge

relations.note: He defends Evendo from Kav colonists.
relations.quote: defending it from Kav colonists who attempt to claim it for themselves
